records.event: Anzu Robotics, Cogito Tech / SPECTA, and SkyRover / Knowact will continue to be identified as gray zone entities due to their reliance on DJI technology and infrastructure.
records.evidence_basis: Existing PIE flags indicate Anzu Robotics uses DJI Mavic 3 hardware, relabeled DJI RC Pro controllers, DJI firmware, and DJI SDK, with SecNeo/BangCle security framework present. Cogito Tech / SPECTA's Specta Air has identical PCBs to DJI Air 3 and uses the DJI P1 chipset. SkyRover / Knowact's app connects directly to DJI cloud infrastructure, uses identical encryption keys to DJI, and allows DJI credential login. All three are flagged for technology licensed from DJI and/or firmware signed with DJI crypto keys, and/or OTA updates touching adversary infrastructure, and/or banned components detected.
records.impact: Continued classification as gray zone entities will likely restrict their market access in the US defense and government sectors due to NDAA §848 enforcement and related regulatory scrutiny.
drivers: Ongoing technical analysis revealing DJI componentry and software dependencies
records.comparison_basis: same question and criteria; shared evidence

records.event: The US Air Force will have at least 500 autonomous Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) in service by 2032.
records.evidence_basis: Secretary of the Air Force Troy Meink announced this goal during a keynote address at the Air & Space Forces Association’s 2026 Air, Space & Cyber Conference.
records.impact: This ambitious goal signals a significant shift towards autonomous systems in US Air Force operations, potentially driving increased R&D and acquisition in AI and autonomy.
drivers: Advancements in AI and autonomous flight technology
records.comparison_basis: same question and criteria; shared evidence

records.event: The US Navy will continue to expand its unmanned aircraft capabilities with the production and deployment of the MQ-25A Stingray unmanned tanker.
records.evidence_basis: The Navy awarded a $562 million fixed-price incentive contract to Boeing for Lot 1 Low Rate Initial Production of the MQ-25A Stingray. Acting Secretary of the Navy Hung Cao teed up the LRIP and deployment announcement in May.
records.impact: The MQ-25A will be the Defense Department’s first unmanned tanker and the Navy’s first operational carrier-based unmanned aircraft, extending the life of F/A-18 Super Hornets and relieving fighter jets of aerial refueling duties.
drivers: Technological advancements in unmanned aerial systems
records.comparison_basis: same question and criteria; shared evidence

records.event: Russia will continue to accelerate the development and mass production of inexpensive precision weapons, including jet-powered drones and cruise missiles, outpacing Ukraine and the US.
records.evidence_basis: A Wall Street Journal report indicates Russia has accelerated the development and mass production of a new generation of relatively inexpensive precision weapons, such as the Geran-5 drone and Banderol cruise missile, moving from testing to large-scale manufacturing faster than Ukraine and the US.
records.impact: This trend suggests a potential shift in the balance of power in drone warfare, with Russia gaining an advantage in cost-effective, mass-produced offensive drone capabilities.
drivers: Lessons learned from ongoing conflict in Ukraine
records.comparison_basis: same question and criteria; shared evidence

records.event: The British Army's Project Halo Shield has successfully transitioned passive counter-UAS concepts from experimentation to operational capability.
records.evidence_basis: UK Defence Innovation (UKDI) provided details that Project Halo Shield, an initiative by the British Army’s Experimentation and Trials Group (ETG), delivered a layered detection capability to give end users a clearer, more reliable picture of the airspace around bases. This was achieved by backing suppliers Dedrone by Axon and Quell, with whom ETG had already worked through field demonstrations and C-UAS exercises.
records.impact: Enhances the British Army's defensive capabilities against uncrewed aerial systems, potentially leading to further procurement of passive C-UAS technologies.
drivers: Successful experimentation and trials with suppliers Dedrone by Axon and Quell.
records.comparison_basis: same question and criteria; shared evidence

records.event: The US Air Force aims to have at least 500 autonomous Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) in service by 2032.
records.evidence_basis: Secretary of the Air Force Troy Meink announced this goal during a keynote address at the Air & Space Forces Association’s 2026 Air, Space & Cyber Conference, where he also named the FQ-42A and FQ-44A as "Vengeance" and "Fury" respectively.
records.impact: Significant long-term demand for autonomy-related technologies, AI, and associated hardware (e.g., STM32H7, NVIDIA Orin, Doodle Labs Helix) for CCA development and production. This ambitious goal will drive substantial procurement and R&D efforts.
drivers: Strategic shift towards autonomous aircraft to perform missions currently completed by manned fighters.
Desire to achieve a significantly different force structure by 2032.

records.event: Russia is outpacing Ukraine and the US in the development and mass production of inexpensive, jet-powered precision weapons, including the Geran-5 drone and Banderol cruise missile.
records.evidence_basis: A WSJ report indicates that Russia has accelerated the development and mass production of a new generation of relatively inexpensive precision weapons, moving from testing to large-scale manufacturing faster than Ukraine and the US. The ENICS E95M jet target drone was displayed in Kyiv in May 2025.
records.impact: This trend highlights a potential capability gap for the US and Ukraine in rapidly developing and deploying cost-effective, mass-producible one-way attack drones. It may drive increased investment in similar programs by Western nations.
drivers: Lessons learned from ongoing conflicts, emphasizing the utility of inexpensive, mass-produced weapons.
Russia's industrial capacity and strategic focus on this class of weapons.
records.comparison_basis: same question and criteria; shared evidence
